L01.text: If you jumped into a hole straight through the Earth, you'd pop out the other side in thirty-eight minutes.

L02.text: The deepest hole we ever actually dug is twelve kilometers. They gave up when the rock hit a hundred and eighty degrees.

L03.text: So let's cheat. One tunnel, pole to pole, with all the air pumped out.

L05.text: Within a minute, you've passed every hole humans ever dug.

L06.text: And weirdly, gravity gets stronger as you fall, because you're closing in on the heavy iron core.

L07.text: Thirteen minutes in, you're shooting through an ocean of liquid iron, as hot as the surface of the Sun.

L08.text: At the center, you're doing over twenty-eight thousand kilometers an hour. And you weigh nothing at all.

L09.text: Luckily, gravity now pulls you back and slows you down.

L10.text: Unluckily, it stops you exactly at the far end, for about half a second.

L11.text: Miss the edge, and you fall all the way home. Like a kid on a swing: fastest in the middle, stopped at each end.

L12.text: Leave the air in, and drag holds you to two hundred kilometers an hour. After more than a day, you'd end up floating at the center of the Earth. Forever.

L13.text: The plane is slower. But it has snacks.
